verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a monitoring feature that watches a page, sitemap, or dataset on a schedule and delivers signed change events, which points to a first-party outbound event subscription. The evidence never explicitly calls these webhooks or describes registering an HTTP endpoint. Async batch jobs appear to rely on progress tracking (polling) rather than callbacks. Missing for 10: explicit webhook endpoint registration docs, an event type catalog beyond change monitoring, signature verification and retry details, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and receive signed change events.
